doc.title: Jay McShann interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, April 12, 1996

title: Segregated audiences kept apart by a rope
summary: At some dances whites and blacks were on separate sides, divided by a rope.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Were you playing for segregated audiences at that time?
Yes. In some places we played I mean whites on this side and blacks on that side you know.
How did they keep them apart?
How did they keep them apart?
Well they might have a rope coming down.
